description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. The three literal forms and no other: a language-tagged skos:prefLabel with no datatype (form a), a typed xsd:dateTime (form b), and plain xsd:string literals written bare in Turtle and with an explicit ^^<...#string> in N-Quads (form c). The expectation is the whole file, not clause fragments, and the predicates are in AGSC-05-10(c) order, which is the order of the predicate IRI and NOT of the prefixed name: dcterms:modified (http://purl.org/dc/terms/modified) sorts BEFORE rdf:type (http://www.w3.org/1999/...), so the block opens on dcterms:modified and 'a' appears on the second clause. dcterms:modified itself is the AGSC-05-26 row: a date-only source value is rendered at midnight UTC by AGSC-04-10, giving 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.
